tools.name: policy_example
tools.description: Free. Worked allow/require_approval/deny verdicts from the live policy engine, so you can judge the service before paying for it.

tools.name: policy_rules
tools.description: Free. The full built-in policy: every tier, rule, condition and rationale. Nothing about how a verdict is reached is hidden.

tools.name: policy_check
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed agent action against a policy and return allow / require_approval / deny with the matched rule and rationale. Paid per call via x402 ($0.005 USDC on Base); returns signing instructions when unpaid.

tools.name: first_42_sponsor
tools.description: Pay Fieldproof $42. Returns every live rail: Stripe card_uri, EIP-681 usdc_uri, BIP-21 btc_uri, x402 POST /v1/sponsor, Zelle, and GET /v1/invoice. One settlement meets the first-$42 bar.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: first_42_sponsor · Public sink: first_42_sponsor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: first_42_sponsor · Public sink: first_42_sponsor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
